NGA.note: Biometric matching searches are stated, but no authentication, e-signature or PKI service.
Gives a count of NINs issued but no population or share.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports NIMC renewed Idemia's contract for three years to upgrade the existing national biometric system, add ABIS licences and provide maintenance and support services.

systems.platform: Idemia IBRS ABIS with OSIA interfaces

NGA.note: Nothing on other registers using the ID number.

facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing the World Bank, says Nigeria has issued more than 104 million biometric digital IDs under the National Identity Number and is on track for 148 million by 30 June.
NIMC's ABIS, being upgraded by Idemia, is to support a million 1:1 and 1:n biometric searches per day, for up to 250 million records.

NGA.note: No relying body using ID verification is named.
OSIA is a vendor-aligned ID standard, not a government framework for its systems.
System is upgraded and supported by a contractor; no government staff stated.
